entities.summary: Tydings-McDuffie Act, a significant document in the history of Philippines (1901–1941). Part of Philippine-American War and Colonial Period. Shaped Battle of Bud Dajo — US forces massacre Moro villagers in Sulu and Philippine Commonwealth established with Manuel Quezon as president.
